app.title: Reactor Drift
app.interactionSummary: The participant can set one cooling level from the current public reactor readings. Examples: '先降温' means choose a higher reactor.set_cooling level when heat is excessive; '别降过头' means select a bounded level that moves the visible reading toward its safe interval.

reactor.set_cooling.description: Set one exact available cooling level from state.actions after reading state.metrics heat, trend, and safe interval.

level.description: Cooling level from zero through three.
